visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, vibrant red hair and a white collared shirt sits indoors, cradling a large, fluffy Ragdoll cat with blue eyes and cream-colored fur. She looks directly into the lens with a warm, cheerful expression. Behind her, a white bookshelf displays several volumes, and the lighting is bright and even. (2) The camera switches to a jarring extreme close-up of the woman's face, specifically her cheek and jawline. Her skin is covered in red, inflamed patches and small bumps, suggesting an allergic reaction. The setting is less clear but appears to be the same bright indoor environment. (3) The view shifts to the cat resting on a beige surface. A hand reaches in from the top of the frame to gently stroke the cat's forehead. The cat's blue eyes are prominent, and its ears are slightly twitching. The background is a soft-focus indoor scene. (4) A very brief cut shows the cat's face again in a tight framing, emphasizing its calm demeanor and physical features. (5) The video ends with a shocking close-up of a human eye. The white part of the eye is intensely bloodshot with visible red veins, and the surrounding skin is puffy and red. The iris is brown, and the gaze is directed forward.
